x-nfl-public-starter-policy.description: MCP starters clear reference examples after defaults and seed sourced recurring sections. The explicit starter regression suite verifies public and full builds; normal generation does not run builds or tests.

viewOnlineLink.description: Authored view-online URL or tracked link is preserved. For a managed Adjacency artifact, use its exact active publishedUrl from the publication registry and validate the complete destination live before building. Never infer an artifact destination from a content file path, source ref, slug, or route pattern. Public newsletter issue links retain their issue-id publication contract.

show_bottom_rule.description: Render the light divider after the ad unless explicitly false.

title.description: Plain-text section heading. Author punctuation directly; the renderer escapes HTML once, preserving literal entity text and treating markup as text.

borderRadius.description: Optional CSS radius applied to the section's outer corners, such as 10px.

sectionHeaderHeadingStylesInline.description: Build-generated heading CSS; font-family values, including fallback fonts, are normalized before serialization to avoid escaped quotes in CSS inlining.

renderFor.description: Edition visibility. Omit or use both to render in both editions.

space_top.description: Extra space above the card in pixels; added to any preceding section spacing. Zero removes this spacer. Accepts a nonnegative number, a numeric string, or a px string such as 32px.

border_width.description: Border thickness in pixels. Zero removes the border. Accepts a nonnegative number, a numeric string, or a px string such as 32px.

border_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels. Zero gives square corners. Accepts a nonnegative number, a numeric string, or a px string such as 32px.

font_family.description: Use mono, sans, or a CSS font-family stack such as Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif.

statement.description: CTA copy with optional HTML. Blank lines separate paragraphs when the value contains no block HTML; authored block HTML is preserved.

space_bottom.description: Extra space below the card in pixels; added to any following section spacing. Zero removes this spacer. Accepts a nonnegative number, a numeric string, or a px string such as 32px.
